resources.string: Working changes, committed checkpoints and finalized observations are separate. Finalization stores an encrypted package. Submission requires separate confirmation.
Protected draft unavailable. Changes may remain in the working copy. Recheck the project and server permission.
Save working text answers before continuing.
Publish a validated checkpoint of the saved working answers and photos? This does not submit the record.
Saved working changes are not committed. Commit them before finalization.
Not finalized. Complete all reviewed answers and photographs before finalization.
Completeness and package check passed. Finalization still requires confirmation.
Finalization check did not pass. Review all answers, photographs and server permission, then retry.
Finalized securely on this device. Not submitted.
Finalize this exact committed checkpoint and store the encrypted observation and photographs? This does not submit the observation.
Send this exact finalized observation and its photographs to the authorized server? After submission begins, editing and another submission from this screen are blocked until the result is verified.
Submitted and verified on the server. Editing and resubmission are blocked.
Submission status could not be verified. The protected observation is retained. Do not resubmit or edit. Refresh status when connected.
Submission was not verified. Review the current state and server permission before proceeding.
